thread:
Olivia: hey team :wave: first day — hitting a couple cloud blocks. Tried to create a test project in eu-west4, gcloud fails with `ERROR: (gcloud.projects.create) The caller does not have permission to create projects (Permission 'resourcemanager.projects.create' denied).` Also tried to assume the AWS cross-account role arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer and got AccessDenied. Who should I ping to get a sandbox project + assume-role perms? I'm on the eng team. Thanks!

Rohan: welcome Olivia! For the GCP org-policy you need an org-admin or infra to provision a project — @Maya-Cloud handles sandbox projects. For AWS you likely need the cross-account role trust updated to include your SAML/Okta principal; @Samir handles billing/linking and can loop infra in. Can you paste the exact error outputs?

Olivia: sure — gcloud error copy:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.projects.create) ResponseError: code=403, message=Project creation prohibited by Organization Policy: constraints/resourcemanager.allowedResourceTypes
```
and AWS:
```
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer
```

Maya-Cloud: Hi Olivia — I can create a sandbox for you. I need your GitHub id and desired project-id prefix. Note we can only enable billing after @Samir links the billing account to the project. Samir, can you link the ENG-Playground billing acct to the new sandbox? :lock:

Samir: on it. Filing a billing-link request now (ticket CL-4321). Once that's done Maya can create the project and enable APIs. For AWS I'll update the role trust to include your SAML principal so you can assume the role. Expect changes in ~2-4 hours.

infra-bot: Created infra ticket INF-9876 for project creation + AWS role trust update. Assigned to Maya-Cloud. ETA 3h. Link: https://tickets.internal/INF-9876

Rohan: FYI after provisioning you can run these locally to test (you won't be able to until infra creates the project):
```
gcloud auth login --brief
gcloud projects create olivia-sbox-1 --folder=123456789012 --name="Olivia sandbox"
```
Org policy will block until infra does it though. For AWS after trust is updated try: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer --role-session-name olivia-test`

Olivia: thanks — my GitHub id is olivia-k and prefer project-id `olivia-sbox-1`. I also need compute + pubsub + kms enabled. I added that to the ticket. Anything else to include?

Maya-Cloud: include the list of APIs (done) and whether you need a VPC with egress to us-east4 or any shared VPC attachment. If you need VPC Service Controls, mention it explicitly — that affects how we set the org policy.

Olivia: added the APIs and noted egress to us-east4. Quick Q: how do I confirm AWS sts:AssumeRole works once Samir updates it? I tried the CLI and got denied earlier.

Samir: once I update the trust policy, test with: `aws sts get-caller-identity` then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/Redwood-Engineer --role-session-name olivia-test`. If it still fails, send me the CLI output with `--debug` and I'll take a look.

Olivia: will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup: appreciate the fast help!
